name: AAMP
fullNameNote: The expansion above is the one used by the AAMP hub README. Two other expansions appear elsewhere in the same corpus.
summary: An IAB Tech Lab umbrella over independently versioned agentic advertising projects spanning three planes: a control plane derived from OpenDirect 2.1, a serve-time bidstream mutation framework (ARTF), and an embedding-exchange data plane (Agentic Audiences).

layers.title: Control plane
layers.description: Planning and transaction time: discovery, avails, quotes, negotiation, deal booking and change requests between buyer and seller agents.

layers.title: Real-time plane
layers.description: Serve time: in-path agents mutate an OpenRTB bid request or response.

layers.title: Data plane
layers.description: Signal exchange: embeddings with consent, TTL and attestation metadata.

areas.title: Control plane — canonical wire contract
areas.summary: The shared buyer-to-seller object and message contract, published as JSON Schema in iab-agentic-primitives and imported by both reference agents.

areas.title: Seller agent API
areas.summary: IAB OpenDirect 2.1 compliant seller agent for programmatic advertising.

areas.title: Buyer agent API
areas.summary: Automated advertising buyer agent using CrewAI and IAB OpenDirect 2.1.

areas.title: Agentic Direct (OpenDirect over MCP)
areas.summary: MCP Server implementation of IAB Tech Lab OpenDirect v2.1 specification for programmatic direct advertising inventory management

areas.title: Agentic Real-Time Framework (ARTF)
areas.summary: Serve-time plane: a host platform synchronously calls in-path agents, which return JSON-Patch-like mutations to a bid request or response.

areas.title: Agentic Audiences
areas.summary: Data plane: agents exchange embeddings carrying identity, contextual and reinforcement signals, with consent and attestation in the envelope.

The AAMP hub README does not list iab-agentic-primitives, even though both reference agents pin it as their canonical wire contract.

AAMP has no single version number. Each repository versions independently: AAMP 3b20e67, agentic-direct 915bda9, buyer-agent v2.3.0-24-g0c3a154, seller-agent v2.4.1, registry-agent-example 1ff8dda, agentic-rtb-framework v1.0-1-g7f48161, agentic-audiences 106ebd6, iab-agentic-primitives v0.5.0-1-g2fc7029.

The corpus expands the AAMP acronym three different ways: "Agentic Advertising Management Protocols" (hub README), "IAB Agent & API Management Protocol" (seller-agent architecture docs), and "Agent-to-Agent Marketplace Protocol" (seller-agent and buyer-agent guides).
